gloss: on time; on schedule; as scheduled

definitions.explanation: Exactly at the planned or expected time. Used to describe events, arrivals, departures, and actions happening as scheduled.

examples.japanese: {時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The trains are running on schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{遅|おく}れない→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ようにして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The meeting will start on time, so please make sure you're not late.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time) + {通|どお}り (as, in accordance with). Literally means "as the time dictates" — i.e., at the appointed time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (to come on time)
- {時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to start on time)
- {時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to arrive on time [deliveries])
- {時間通|じかんどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to proceed on schedule)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定刻|ていこく}→定刻：16982_teikoku⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧ — on the dot, at the appointed time; more formal, used for scheduled departure/arrival times
- ⟦{予定通|よていどお}り→予定通り：15290_yoteidoori⟧ — as planned; broader, covering any kind of plan, not just time
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧ — to be in time; focuses on making it before a deadline

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's emphasis on punctuality makes {時間通|じかんどお}り a frequently used expression. Japanese trains are famously {時間通|じかんどお}り, and even slight delays prompt formal announcements and apologies.
